project.name: bananascaler
project.description: GPU-accelerated neural video upscaler CLI with an interactive Bubbletea TUI. Orchestrates Real-ESRGAN for per-frame super-resolution and FFmpeg for hardware-accelerated encoding and audio muxing.

nodes.name: root.go
nodes.summary: Cobra root command for bananascaler: defines global flags, runs profile resolution/validation, routes to TUI or plain pipeline mode, and hosts the detect hardware subcommand.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses golang.org/x/term.IsTerminal to choose TUI vs stdout logger when --no-tui is unset.

nodes.name: tui.go
nodes.summary: Registers the tui subcommand that launches the interactive file-manager TUI with empty Input so users pick videos from the working directory.

nodes.name: messages.go
nodes.summary: Defines pipeline event kinds, log level constants, and PipelineEvent plus Bubbletea message wrappers bridging the pipeline goroutine to the TUI model.

nodes.name: model_test.go
nodes.summary: Unit tests for video file detection, model name shortening, and explorer keybinds/navigation (scale/GPU/model cycling and j/k cursor movement).

nodes.name: pipeline_adapter_test.go
nodes.summary: Table-driven tests for parseStep, covering bracketed stage messages, missing brackets, empty brackets, and multi-digit stage numbers.

nodes.name: styles.go
nodes.summary: Lipgloss color palette, layout constants, and shared TUI styles for panels, stages, progress bars, logs, footer keybinds, and the file explorer.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Program entry point that delegates to cmd.Execute to run the bananascaler Cobra CLI.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Binary entry point that calls cmd.Execute to start the Cobra CLI.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Public CLI entry invoked by main: executes the root Cobra command and exits non-zero with a styled error on failure.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Registers persistent flags for output, scale, GPU, model, verbosity, TUI toggle, and profile/auto-detect, then attaches the detect subcommand.

nodes.name: PipelineEvent
nodes.summary: Event payload from the pipeline goroutine to the TUI carrying kind, log level, message text, and stage progress fields.

nodes.name: TestIsVideoFile
nodes.summary: Table test verifying isVideoFile accepts common video extensions (case-insensitive) and rejects non-video names.

nodes.name: TestShortModel
nodes.summary: Table test for shortModel display names stripping realesr/realesrgan prefixes from model identifiers.

nodes.name: TestModelExplorerKeybinds
nodes.summary: Exercises Model.Update keybinds in file-select state: cycles scale (s), GPU (g), and model (m) through expected values.

nodes.name: TestModelExplorerNavigation
nodes.summary: Integration-style test that loads a temp dir of videos into the explorer and asserts j/k cursor movement with bounds clamping.

nodes.name: TestParseStep
nodes.summary: Validates parseStep extracts stage index and name from [n/m] messages and handles malformed or empty bracket cases.

nodes.name: renderBar
nodes.summary: Renders a segmented progress bar with green fill when done and blue body plus amber lead edge while active.

nodes.name: repeat
nodes.summary: Repeats a string n times via strings.Builder, returning empty string for non-positive n.

nodes.name: renderFooterBinds
nodes.summary: Builds the footer keybind hint row by styling key/description pairs and joining them with muted separators.

nodes.name: config.go
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration for a bananascaler run: CLI-derived settings, hardware profile resolution, validation, and default output/model application.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Holds input/output paths, scale, GPU index, model, verbosity, TUI flags, and optional UpscaleProfile with auto-detect/preset controls.

nodes.name: ResolveProfile
nodes.summary: Applies profile selection: auto-detect with optional preset, user preset alone, or legacy defaults without a profile.

nodes.name: applyProfileDefaults
nodes.summary: Copies model and max-scale caps from the active profile into Config when the user has not overridden them via CLI.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Checks scale range and input existence, fills default output path and model, and enforces profile MaxScale.

nodes.name: ProfileSummary
nodes.summary: Returns a one-line string describing the active profile or legacy model/scale settings for logs.

nodes.name: detect.go
nodes.summary: Dependency checks and media probes: PATH tools (ffmpeg/ffprobe/realesrgan), NVIDIA presence, framerate, and audio-stream detection via ffprobe.

nodes.name: CheckDeps
nodes.summary: Verifies ffmpeg, ffprobe, and realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan are available on PATH before a run.

nodes.name: HasNVIDIA
nodes.summary: Returns true if nvidia-smi runs successfully within a short timeout.

nodes.name: Framerate
nodes.summary: Uses ffprobe to read the first video stream's r_frame_rate for re-encode framerate preservation.

nodes.name: HasAudio
nodes.summary: Uses ffprobe to detect whether the input has any audio streams for remux decisions.

nodes.name: profile.go
nodes.summary: GPU detection via nvidia-smi, VRAM-based hardware tiers, preset profile database (tile/model/encode params), auto-profiling, and tile OOM safety checks.

nodes.name: GPUInfo
nodes.summary: Detected GPU snapshot: name, VRAM MB, NVIDIA availability, and CPU core count.

nodes.name: UpscaleProfile
nodes.summary: Tunable upscale parameters: tier/preset, Real-ESRGAN tile and model, JPEG quality, NVENC/x265 encode settings, and max scale.

nodes.name: AllPresets
nodes.summary: Returns the three preset levels: fast, balanced, and quality.

nodes.name: ParsePreset
nodes.summary: Parses user preset strings (including short aliases) into PresetLevel or returns an error.

nodes.name: String
nodes.summary: Formats UpscaleProfile as a short human-readable tier/preset/tile/model summary.

nodes.name: DetectGPU
nodes.summary: Queries nvidia-smi for GPU name and total VRAM; returns zero-value GPUInfo when no NVIDIA GPU is found.

nodes.name: DetectGPUCount
nodes.summary: Counts NVIDIA GPUs by parsing nvidia-smi GPU index lines.

nodes.name: classifyTier
nodes.summary: Maps VRAM thresholds to low-end, mid-range, high-end, or unknown hardware tiers.

nodes.name: profileDB
nodes.summary: Builds the full tier×preset matrix of UpscaleProfile values tuned for VRAM budgets and quality tradeoffs.

nodes.name: GetProfile
nodes.summary: Looks up a profile by hardware tier and preset, falling back to unknown/balanced.

nodes.name: GetDefaultProfile
nodes.summary: Returns the balanced profile for a given hardware tier.

nodes.name: AutoProfile
nodes.summary: Detects GPU, classifies tier, and returns the recommended balanced UpscaleProfile with GPUInfo.

nodes.name: AutoProfileWithPreset
nodes.summary: Detects GPU tier and returns a profile for the caller's preferred fast/balanced/quality preset.

nodes.name: ProfileSummary
nodes.summary: One-line hardware plus tier/preset summary for CLI/TUI status lines.

nodes.name: ProfileDisplay
nodes.summary: Multi-line verbose dump of tile, model, JPEG quality, NVENC/x265 encode settings, and max scale.

nodes.name: maxSafeTile
nodes.summary: Heuristic maximum safe Real-ESRGAN tile size from VRAM and model weight class.

nodes.name: CheckTileSafety
nodes.summary: Returns a warning string when requested tile size may OOM on the detected GPU; empty if safe.

nodes.name: pipeline.go
nodes.summary: Core upscale pipeline: validate config, probe media, extract frames with ffmpeg, Real-ESRGAN upscale with progress, re-encode/mux (NVENC or libx265), with signal cleanup.

nodes.name: Logger
nodes.summary: Interface abstracting pipeline log/progress output so CLI stdout or TUI can drive the same Run path.

nodes.name: StdoutLogger
nodes.summary: ANSI-colored Logger implementation that prints pipeline events and progress bars to the terminal.

nodes.name: Progress
nodes.summary: StdoutLogger progress renderer that prints stage current/total percentage and advances the line when complete.

nodes.name: pipelineParams
nodes.summary: Resolves effective tile size, JPEG quality, and encode presets from profile or legacy defaults.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full three-stage pipeline: frame extraction, neural upscale, re-encode+mux with temp dirs, cancel on SIGINT/SIGTERM, and atomic rename.

nodes.name: upscale
nodes.summary: Runs realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan on extracted frames and polls output PNGs every 200ms to report stage-2 progress.

nodes.name: runCmd
nodes.summary: Runs an external command under context with stderr always wired and optional verbose stdout.

nodes.name: countFiles
nodes.summary: Counts non-directory entries with a given extension in a directory for frame progress totals.

nodes.name: model.go
nodes.summary: Bubbletea TUI model: file explorer for video selection, live pipeline stage progress/logs, preset/model/GPU keybinds, and View rendering with lipgloss.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Main Bubbletea model holding config, event/done channels, three pipeline stages, log buffer, window size, and file-explorer navigation state.

nodes.name: NewModel
nodes.summary: Constructs the TUI model, auto-selects a hardware profile when missing, and starts in explorer or pipeline state based on Input.

nodes.name: Init
nodes.summary: Bubbletea Init: enter alt screen, start event wait loop, and load directory listing when selecting a file.

nodes.name: readDirCmd
nodes.summary: Async command that reads the current directory, skips dotfiles, and returns dirs then files for the explorer.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Central Bubbletea Update routing window resize, directory results, keys, pipeline events, and completion/quit.

nodes.name: updateExplorer
nodes.summary: Handles explorer keybinds: navigate, cycle scale/GPU/model/preset, enter dirs, and launch pipeline.Run on video selection.

nodes.name: handlePipelineEvent
nodes.summary: Applies log and stage start/progress/done pipeline events to model state and re-arms the event wait command.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Bubbletea View entry: interrupted banner, file explorer layout, or live pipeline progress UI.

nodes.name: viewExplorer
nodes.summary: Renders the file selector: header, path, scrollable listing with video highlighting, option badges, and help keys.

nodes.name: viewPipeline
nodes.summary: Renders pipeline UI: title, stage cards with progress, scrolling log pane, and status footer.

nodes.name: renderStage
nodes.summary: Renders one of the three pipeline stages with status icon, name, and progress bar or counters.

nodes.name: config_test.go
nodes.summary: Table-driven unit tests for Config.Validate covering scale bounds, missing input, default output/model, and custom path/model preservation.

nodes.name: TestConfigValidate
nodes.summary: Creates a temp input file and runs Validate cases: valid defaults, invalid scale, missing input, and custom output/model retention.

nodes.name: pipeline_test.go
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the upscale pipeline using mocked ffmpeg/ffprobe/realesrgan/nvidia-smi on PATH, plus countFiles unit coverage.

nodes.name: mockLogger
nodes.summary: Test double implementing pipeline.Logger that records info messages, stages, and completion for assertions.

nodes.name: TestPipelineIntegration
nodes.summary: End-to-end Run test with shell mocks for external tools; asserts output file creation and progress for stages 1–3.

nodes.name: TestCountFiles
nodes.summary: Verifies countFiles counts only regular files matching an extension and ignores directories with matching names.

nodes.name: pipeline_adapter.go
nodes.summary: Bridges pipeline.Logger to Bubbletea: tuiLogger emits PipelineEvents, parseStep detects stage starts, RunTUI launches the program and optional background Run.

nodes.name: tuiLogger
nodes.summary: pipeline.Logger implementation that sends log, stage-start, progress, and stage-done events on a channel to the TUI model.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: Parses step messages for stage starts via parseStep, emits EventStageStart when applicable, then logs the step message.

nodes.name: Progress
nodes.summary: Maps stage/current/total progress into EventStageProgress or EventStageDone, ignoring the zero/zero initial call.

nodes.name: parseStep
nodes.summary: Parses "[n/m] Stage name..." messages into stage index and remaining name text; returns zeros on malformed input.

nodes.name: RunTUI
nodes.summary: Creates the TUI model, optionally starts pipeline.Run in a goroutine when Input is set, and runs Bubbletea with alt screen.

nodes.name: go.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that checks out the repo, sets up Go from go.mod, builds all packages, and runs the full test suite on push and pull requests to main.

tour.title: What is bananascaler?
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the product: a GPU-accelerated neural video upscaler that drives Real-ESRGAN and FFmpeg, with a live Bubbletea dashboard.

tour.title: Binary entry point
tour.description: main.go is a thin entry that delegates to the Cobra root command. All CLI flags, subcommands, and TUI launch flow start here.

tour.title: Hardware-aware profiles
tour.description: Before upscaling, the tool detects NVIDIA GPUs and selects a hardware tier and preset so VRAM limits and quality tradeoffs stay safe.

tour.title: Core processing pipeline
tour.description: The pipeline package orchestrates frame extraction, Real-ESRGAN per-frame upscaling, re-encoding, and audio mux — the heart of every job.

tour.title: Interactive TUI dashboard
tour.description: When run in a terminal, Bubbletea renders progress, stages, and logs. The model and pipeline adapter bridge UI events to the pipeline.

tour.title: Build, test, and CI
tour.description: Makefile and go.mod define local builds; GitHub Actions builds and tests every push to main so regressions are caught early.
